tasks.label: Locate controlling authority
tasks.description: Identify the highest relevant binding source and adverse authority, not merely a topical document.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Official work/case/rule identity plus selected passage and court/institutional competence.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live verification at answer time for current advice; historical date fixed for retrospective research.
failure_modes: later appeal or higher authority missed
tasks.success: Controlling authority is identified, hierarchy and jurisdiction are stated, and every material proposition has a pinpoint.

tasks.label: Determine whether law is in force
tasks.description: Establish operative status for the relevant date, territory, person and facts.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Versioned legislation, commencement/effect records, extent and amendments with live official verification.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Zero tolerance for stale current-law answers.
failure_modes: latest text confused with in-force text
tasks.success: Answer states the relevant version, commencement, extent, amendments, savings and uncertainty.

tasks.label: Point-in-time and historical research
tasks.description: Reconstruct the law and official materials as at a specified date.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Dated expressions, amendment chronology, archived official material and source hashes.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Exact historical cut-off; later material segregated.
failure_modes: current consolidation substituted for historical text
archive date mistaken for legal date
tasks.success: A reproducible dated state and change chronology are supplied.

tasks.label: Territorial extent and jurisdiction
tasks.description: Determine where and to whom a source applies and which institution has competence.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Extent metadata, devolution/competence provisions, court or regulator jurisdiction sources.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live for current competence; exact for historical jurisdiction.
tasks.success: Territory, legal system, institutional competence and exceptions are explicit.

tasks.label: Trace amendments, commencement and repeal
tasks.description: Identify effects made/received and whether they are applied, pending or spent.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Official effect feeds, amending instruments/provisions, commencement orders and selected passages.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live verification at answer time.
failure_modes: absence of recorded effect treated as no effect
tasks.success: Bidirectional change graph and current application status are evidenced.

tasks.label: Identify judicial interpretation and treatment
tasks.description: Find cases interpreting a provision/proposition and classify treatment.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Official judgments, cited passage, court hierarchy, later treatment and appeal status.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live citator/treatment check before reliance.
tasks.success: Treatment verbs are passage-evidenced and hierarchy/date qualified.

tasks.label: Construct a chronology
tasks.description: Order enactment, commencement, litigation, guidance, decisions and implementation events.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Typed dated events with source identity, event date and publication/retrieval date separated.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Depends on task; current chronologies checked live.
failure_modes: publication date confused with effective date
tasks.success: A typed, source-backed chronology exposes gaps and conflicting dates.

tasks.label: Compare jurisdictions
tasks.description: Compare materially equivalent rules, remedies or procedures across UK legal systems or international sources.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Separate authoritative sources per jurisdiction with explicit non-equivalence.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Same effective date across compared systems.
tasks.success: Differences, commonalities, dates and institutional contexts are separately sourced.

tasks.label: Apply rules to facts
tasks.description: Structure legal analysis against supplied facts without inventing missing facts.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Controlling text/cases, issue-element mapping, stated factual assumptions and uncertainty.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live for current advice; professional review required.
tasks.success: Elements, exceptions, burdens and missing facts are mapped, with escalation.

tasks.label: Find procedural steps, deadlines, forms and fees
tasks.description: Identify the correct route, time limit, form, fee and exceptions.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Current rule/order/practice direction plus live form/fee/service verification.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Same-day/live verification before action.
failure_modes: guidance deadline not checked against rule
tasks.success: Actionable steps cite the operative procedural passage and current service artefacts.

tasks.label: Prepare litigation, advice, policy, compliance or enforcement work
tasks.description: Assemble a balanced authority pack for a professional deliverable.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Authority-ranked source set, selected passages, adverse material, currency and assumptions.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live before issue/decision.
tasks.success: Deliverable is reproducible, balanced and professionally reviewable.

tasks.label: Research legislative intent
tasks.description: Trace Bill versions, debates, explanatory material, reports and implementation history.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Official Bill/stage documents, Hansard passages, explanatory notes and enacted text.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Historical source set fixed; later interpretation segregated.
tasks.success: History is connected to enacted provisions without overstating interpretive weight.

tasks.label: Monitor legal change
tasks.description: Detect, classify and route new or changed legal materials.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Official feeds/logs, hashes, version differences and impact classification.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Source-specific service-level objective; critical sources daily or event-driven.
failure_modes: cosmetic change escalated as legal change
tasks.success: Change event is detected, typed, evidenced, impact-assessed and reviewable.

tasks.label: Quantitative or corpus analysis
tasks.description: Run reproducible analysis over a declared source population.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Licensed corpus, denominator, extraction rules, code/version, missingness and uncertainty.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Snapshot date fixed and disclosed.
failure_modes: database absence treated as real-world absence
tasks.success: Analysis is reproducible and limitations follow from an auditable coverage ledger.

tasks.label: Draft or check legal instruments
tasks.description: Check form, enabling power, competence, cross-references, commencement and consistency.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Enabling provisions, drafting guidance, precedents with status, current affected law and versioned draft.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live at drafting/clearance milestones.
tasks.success: Each drafting proposition and dependency is traceable; human counsel approves.

tasks.label: Produce accessible public explanation
tasks.description: Explain rights, duties or process accurately in plain language and accessible formats.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Authoritative passages plus official service guidance, with simplifications/limits labelled.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live for current rights/process.
tasks.success: Explanation is accurate, scoped, readable, accessible and links to authoritative evidence.

tasks.label: Audit an AI-generated legal answer
tasks.description: Verify authority, passage, currency, jurisdiction, completeness and uncertainty.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Proposition-to-citation ledger, source hashes, version context and coverage declaration.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Re-verify all material current-law propositions.
tasks.success: Every material proposition is supported, classified and risk-rated; hard failures cap the answer.

tasks.label: Identify institutional competence
tasks.description: Establish which body can make, interpret, enforce or review a rule/decision.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Founding/empowering provisions, delegation, jurisdiction and temporal organisation identity.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live for current bodies.
failure_modes: organisation page treated as power source
tasks.success: Competence, delegation, review route and date are sourced.

tasks.label: Identify remedies and enforcement outcomes
tasks.description: Find available remedies, sanctions, appeal/review routes and past outcomes.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Operative remedy provisions, procedure, official decisions/notices and appeal status.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Live for current remedies and routes.
tasks.success: Remedy conditions, forum, deadline, discretion and evidence are explicit.

tasks.label: Verify citation and identity
tasks.description: Resolve citations, aliases, duplicate records, versions and successor identities.
tasks.acceptable_evidence: Source-native identifiers, exact/qualified mappings, issuer and temporal identity.
tasks.default_currency_tolerance: Identity mapping versioned; live where institutions/citations evolve.
tasks.success: Identity decision has mapping type, confidence, evidence and unresolved conflicts.
